reports.title: The Ceasefire That Isn't
reports.subtitle: US and Iran exchange fire in the Strait of Hormuz while both sides insist the war is over.

reports.title: Tariffs Ruled Unlawful, Again. It Still Won't Matter.
reports.subtitle: A federal trade court struck down Trump's 10% global tariffs, but the ruling only protects two importers and one state.

reports.title: Europe Blinks on AI
reports.subtitle: The EU delayed its flagship AI law's core rules by 18 months and exempted industrial AI entirely, handing industry a win critics say undermines the whole point.

reports.title: Moderate Republicans Block Medicaid Cuts, for Now
reports.subtitle: Vulnerable GOP senators blocked the third reconciliation bill over Medicaid fear, but the cuts already signed into law via H.R. 1 are hitting millions of Americans right now.

reports.title: Trump Flies to Beijing With Iran in the Room
reports.subtitle: The Trump-Xi summit next week is nominally about trade and rare earths. Iran has turned it into a negotiation about who controls the ceasefire.

reports.title: The Pentagon Has Picked Its AI Winners. Anthropic Isn't One of Them.
reports.subtitle: The DOD signed eight AI firms onto classified military networks and labeled its former partner a supply chain risk. The line between safety-first and market loser is dissolving.

reports.title: Meta Killed Instagram's Encryption. The Reason It Gave Is the Cover Story.
reports.subtitle: Meta quietly removed end-to-end encryption from Instagram DMs today, citing low user adoption. The timing, the UK regulator fight, and the silence make the real reason obvious.

reports.title: Russia's Victory Day Ceasefire Is Already Over
reports.subtitle: Putin declared a 48-hour truce for May 9 commemorations. Ukraine launched 427 drones into Russia anyway. The ceasefire is real as theater and worthless as strategy.

reports.title: 115,000 Jobs in April. The Iran War Hasn't Hit the Labor Market. Yet.
reports.subtitle: April payrolls nearly doubled economist forecasts despite $4.50 gas and the biggest oil shock since 2022. Either the economy is genuinely resilient, or the damage is still in transit.

reports.title: Judge Calls DOGE's NEH Grant Cuts 'Blatant.' Trump Will Ignore Her.
reports.subtitle: A federal judge ruled 1,400 humanities grants were canceled unconstitutionally by DOGE staffers who used ChatGPT and DEI keywords to slash $100 million in congressionally appropriated funds.
